{"status":"Completed","reason":"Read the current slice intake artifact, confirmed the implementation boundary and exclusions, and wrote the slice architecture decision record for the TetrisGame slice. The record preserves source-of-truth ownership by keeping UI rendering in the Blazor WebAssembly PWA app, gameplay state in typed application/domain code, and persistence out of scope for this slice.","branchOutcomeKey":"","branchOutcomeTitle":"","evidenceRefs":["artifacts/process-runs/1fb9c330-85c7-419a-9a55-6decb509fe4b/steps/slice-intake.md","artifacts/process-runs/1fb9c330-85c7-419a-9a55-6decb509fe4b/steps/slice-architecture-check.md"],"nextActions":["Proceed to implementation with the architecture record as the source-of-truth boundary.","Keep gameplay rules and movement logic in typed application/domain services rather than .razor event handlers.","Defer persistence and broader gameplay mechanics to later slices unless a new intake changes scope."],"humanReadableSummaryMarkdown":"## Result
Completed the architecture check for the TetrisGame slice.

## What I confirmed
- The intake defines a first reviewable MVP: browser-visible playfield plus left/right movement of an active falling tetromino.
- The app remains a Blazor WebAssembly PWA under the grounded product root.
- Persistence is out of scope for this slice.

## Architecture disposition
- UI renders and orchestrates input.
- Typed application/domain code owns gameplay state and movement.
- No infrastructure boundary is needed for this slice.

## Evidence
- Intake artifact: `artifacts/process-runs/1fb9c330-85c7-419a-9a55-6decb509fe4b/steps/slice-intake.md`
- Decision record: `artifacts/process-runs/1fb9c330-85c7-419a-9a55-6decb509fe4b/steps/slice-architecture-check.md`

## Risk note
Avoid placing movement rules in component event handlers or introducing persistence early, as both would blur source-of-truth ownership."}
